pre_registration.question: Does hop-shell RPI-DSATUR beat full recompute on wall-clock at n=2000?
pre_registration.ood_note: GNN trained on n in {100,200,500}. n=2000 is out of distribution. Flagged per evaluation_spec 2.5.
pre_registration.pairing: same graphs and sequential edit streams for both systems
pre_registration.validity: same independent checker as Section 8 matrix (check_validity via *_step)
pre_registration.downsample_rationale: Full 45-graph x 45-edit matrix at n=2000 is too expensive. Prefer fewer graphs over breaking pairing. 8 graphs x 20 edits x 1 seed.
pre_registration.fallback_if_oom: retry at n=1000 with the same protocol
